expectation: Nuclear stain in cycling cells, a minority (about 5-20%). In gut-like epithelium they should sit in the crypt or proliferative zone, as discrete bright nuclei, with the villus tip, muscle and stroma mostly negative.
observed: A: discrete yellow dots line the epithelial edge of the central and left structures and are dense in the narrow central neck. The right striped tissue has only smooth haze. B and C: mostly diffuse yellow haze, with few distinct nuclei and one or two bright blobs. D: one small, very bright blob, not clearly nuclear.
why: Whole-tissue dots follow the epithelial proliferative zone, a plausible Ki67 pattern, but the close-ups are hazy with blob-like spots, so contrast is low.
